segments.text: These things smell of more then Satanicall arrogancie. For what man, but such an one as were not in his right mind, would beleeue, that he, vnto whom so many millions of condemnations are due, could once merit the least dramme of grace. The prodigall sonne, he was not receiued into fauour by reason of his deserts, but by fauour. Luk. 15.21. His sonne said vnto him, I haue sinned against heauen, and against thee, and am no more worthie to be called thy sonne.
